title: FeedMeMe
tagline: FeedMeMe enables transparent, traceable token donations to charities. It gamifies the donation process to create a positive experience for donors, who can contribute multiple cryptocurrencies. This aims to restore trust and simplify the donation workflow.
description:
> All (non-scam) token donations are accepted and converted to stable coins that are then distributed to beneficiaries.
> The key aspects are transparency and traceability - users can see where their donations flow to.
> The donation process is gamified to make it more fun and engaging for donors. 
> Donors can make multi-coin donations, as indicated by the various cryptocurrency icons. This allows for a more diverse donor base.
> The on-chain conversion and distribution of the donated tokens ensures the transparency and traceability of the donation flow, as mentioned earlier.
how_its_made: We noticed that many Web3 interfaces aren’t very user-friendly or enjoyable to interact with, so we set out to create something different. Our app feels a bit like an interactive game, making it fun and engaging while remaining super simple yet powerful. With a drag-and-drop interface built using PIXI.js, seamless onboarding via RainbowKit and web3auth, and support for seven networks, users can easily interact with smart contract methods linked to their wallet tokens. Deployed on Vercel, it’s fast, intuitive, and refreshingly fun for the Web3 space.
